reviews.text: I went to the emergency vet and she treated me wonderfully, both on the phone and later at the clinic. She put me at ease and was very patient and caring with my dog. I'm very grateful for the attention, kindness, and care I received.

We're sorry your review doesn't reflect a satisfactory experience, Miren.

If you'd like to tell us more about what happened or need us to review your case, you can contact us by phone or email. We'd be happy to help.
Excellent service. Both César and Vero provide unbeatable service.
Thank you so much, Laura, for your trust in our team at Blasco Ibáñez 97 Veterinary Clinic in Valencia. Warm regards, and we'll always be here for you whenever you need us.
Thank you so much for your positive feedback, LuisaLego192. We are delighted to know that at Clínica Veterinaria Blasco Ibáñez 97 C.B., in Valencia, we have met your expectations.

The treatment I received was shameful. My dog ​​was in an emergency, and I called in a panic in the middle of the night seeking help. The person who answered was extremely rude and impolite, showing absolutely no empathy for what we were going through. A veterinarian should have compassion as well as professionalism. I will never contact this place again, nor would I recommend it to anyone.
Thank you so much for your feedback, Apolonio! We hope to see you again at Clínica Veterinaria Blasco Ibáñez 97 C.B., in Valencia.
Excellent service and a truly professional experience.

The best vet in the Valencian Community... I've known Cesar for over 25 years, and thanks to him he saved my animals after I went to countless terrible clinics.
Thank you, Cesar, for being the best! 😸
I went there urgently because my dog ​​was bitten, and it turned out to be a superficial wound, but they treated us very well, as always.

The service is good, and they're professional and friendly (although some employees give me free things, while others charge me just for saying "everything's fine"). But I feel really sorry for the fish they have in the tank... they look bored and cramped. That's why I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5.
Excellent service and friendliness.

I have complete confidence in César and the entire team. I've been going to them for many years (now with my second dog and a parakeet), and for me, taking my current dog, who is older and very delicate, there is like taking him to the best specialist I could take a member of my family. They always explore all the options, explain everything perfectly, and have great sensitivity and dedication to their work.
All I can say is: thank you.

I went there a week ago because my dog ​​has degenerative arthritis and they told me he was limping because of a nail problem. Well, it turns out my dog ​​can't even put weight on his paw and he's worse than when I took him. They charged me a fortune just for a nail problem and kicked me out just for telling César things straight. Besides, Juan César is incredibly rude on the phone. They have no clue and charge a different price every day. It's unbelievable! My dog's problem is completely different from what they told me, since the nail issue is due to allergies. It's ridiculous!
Thank you all for being so kind to Chinwen! Especially to Cesar and Paula! They're so sweet to him... thank you for joining us.
Excellent veterinarian. Juan is very kind and explains everything very well. I will definitely return to them for future checkups and vaccinations.

Yesterday I took my dog ​​to the emergency vet because she was in so much pain she couldn't move. The service was excellent; they quickly diagnosed the problem (a pinched spinal cord) and the price was reasonable. She's feeling much better now with the prescribed anti-inflammatories and painkillers. I'm so grateful because they saved her life twice in emergencies. Thank you!

For years, they've been our trusted veterinarian. They treated us wonderfully from the first day we walked in until we had to say goodbye to our pet. They're a team of professionals who do excellent work with love. They were understanding, respectful, competent, and very affectionate with our dog. I will definitely recommend them if you want the best for your pets.

We've been coming here for years with our four-legged vacuum cleaner. We don't know how many times César and his team have saved our dog's life. We wish them all the best; they're fantastic. They're not snake oil salesmen; they're animal veterinarians.
Super professional and very friendly, I totally recommend them. Plus, the shop and hairdressing service are all in one place, my Chocolate is thrilled! 😜 …
A true professional. He saved our bus stopper. Exceptional service.

After arriving in great pain, he was diagnosed with a tumor in his spleen in time, and I simply have no words to thank César and his entire team for extending my dog ​​Kenzo's life. You are incredible. I don't think there's any money or love that can repay all of that. When you know a team has come into this world to save animals, there's no doubt about it, and you can feel it. Thank you all for taking care of him and looking after him. ❤️❤️
Thank you for saving my life. See you on Tuesday.

So far, my experience has been very good. I had a kitten hospitalized for a day, and I felt they did a great job with its treatment because it arrived well-hydrated and recovering, with good instructions, and I think the medication they gave it worked very well. The kitten has recovered perfectly. They also offer a discount on vaccinations for shelter members. My only complaint is that a couple of times I've had to wait a little longer than I would have liked, but they've also been very accommodating in other ways, so as long as you're not in a hurry, I think they're good veterinarians, and the tests they've recommended have always been reasonable and reasonably priced, not exorbitant, so I'll be back. So far, my experience has been very satisfactory with the animals I've taken there (I also took a kitten with a possible food allergy). I recommend them. P.S.: They have a CT scan option at another location.
Excellent service always

We are so thankful.
He saved our dog from an intoxication.

On a Friday night he ate something and acted weird we immediately ran to this vet and we don’t have to wait.
They helped him and after one night we could pick him up again completely fine.

Thank you so much 🫶🏻

100% recommended! I took my cat, who has asthma, during a severe attack, and they knew exactly how to treat him, perform the necessary tests, and, most importantly, explain everything very well. They are excellent professionals. Thank you to the whole team! 💖 …
Very kind
The way they treat both people and their loved ones in their families is spectacular. Thank you for everything.

Juan has been incredibly kind. We took our 7.5-year-old cat, who was suffering from severe kidney failure, to another vet. Because of the cost, they recommended euthanizing our cat, who is like a son to us. But here, they treated him wonderfully and cared for him so well. ❤️‍🩹 After two days of hospitalization, our big boy came home with medication and follow-up care from the vets. Thank you so much for everything! From now on, he will be our go-to vet. ❤️ They saved our baby.
Not recommended. Horrible and painful.

Juan is the best veterinarian I've ever met. He's incredibly kind, clear-headed, detail-oriented, and reliable. He helped me with the necessary paperwork for my four cats to travel from Spain to China. Plus, he speaks English. Thank you so much!


Juan is the best vet I've ever met. He's very kind, clear-headed, detail-oriented, and reliable. He helped me with the necessary paperwork for my four cats to travel from Spain to China. And he speaks English. Thank you so much!
I've trusted them for years to take care of my dogs and cats. They're excellent professionals.

Horrible. They charged the association I was fostering over €1000 for the kitten, kept him hospitalized for two weeks without letting me see him because they said he had panleukopenia, which I could never confirm. When they finally gave him back to me, he was worse than when they took him, covered in vomit, drool, and feces that had been there for days or weeks... They probably never cleaned him at all. Since the cat was dying, I took him to another vet, and they treated him. I saw an improvement in two days, and they told me there had been malpractice in every aspect. They intubated him because he wasn't eating (which was unnecessary), using a tube that was much too big for him since he was a kitten. When they removed it at the other vet, he had an infection from the tube, which caused him more gastrointestinal problems. There was so much negligence with that poor animal, who suffered terribly, and probably even more while he was hospitalized.
They have no tact with animals; just for asking they charge you €30 and they don't offer solutions for animals other than dogs or cats. It's deplorable.

I want to thank Juan and the entire team for their wonderful care. He came to my house and helped me take my dog ​​to the clinic, as she couldn't move. The situation was very difficult for me, but Juan made it so easy. They let me stay with her the whole time, and although I couldn't take her home with me, I'm so grateful for everything. Thank you so much.
Excellent service, hardworking and polite.

First and last time, my dog ​​came out just as she came in without knowing what was wrong with her and the personal service was disappointingly poor, but we did leave with one hundred and thirty euros less, I wouldn't recommend it to anyone, time tells all.
They cured my dog. Thank you.
Good service at affordable prices for all pets and/or companion animals

I've been going to this veterinary clinic for over 10 years, and to this day I have nothing but praise for the entire team. They are professional, friendly, and the care my pets have received has been impeccable, whether for an emergency or a routine visit. I wholeheartedly recommend them because they have always prioritized the well-being of all the animals.

Personally, with my two pets (a rabbit and a dog), the care and trust they instilled in me was outstanding. Their compassion and professionalism in treating and providing the best care are truly appreciated. So, THANK YOU SO MUCH for being such a great team and for your excellent work!
I have no words to describe the professionalism and care the whole team shows for pets. You saved my dog ​​and we will be eternally grateful! ❤

Little empathy and little professionalism.
I took my dog ​​in for a checkup because she wasn't breathing well, and we agreed that they would call me periodically since they had put her on oxygen.
They only called me when she was dying. And when I arrived, they took a long time to open the gate, and my dog ​​had already passed away. I couldn't say goodbye to her. They need their owners at the moment of their death and before it happens. The pain I feel in my chest is indescribable. We should be with them at all times until their last breath. They feel safe and pass away peacefully. My dog ​​was my world, and I was hers.
Well, the truth is, when it comes to something important, even if they're very busy, they take care of my dogs; I have complete confidence in them.

TERRIBLE PERSONAL AND MEDICAL CARE. IT COULDN'T HAVE BEEN WORSE.

We went to the emergency vet on a Saturday night because our usual vet was closed. A man attended to us, and his manner was rude from beginning to end, as if our presence bothered him. Our cat was very weak, with kidney failure or very close to it. He did NOT do any blood tests (the excuse was that his bladder was full—excuse me??), but he still diagnosed dehydration (pretty obvious, thanks) and a urethral stone, which he extracted very painfully without any pain relief and which may have even damaged the urethra (the icing on the cake).

All this for the modest price of only 150 euros. BRAVO! 👏

Now our cat is hospitalized in a coma at our regular vet, FIGHTING FOR LIFE. When we told him that they didn't do any blood tests under those conditions, he couldn't believe it.

Draw your own conclusions.
Always great!!!
Very professional and they treated my bunny very well.

I don't fully recommend them because they don't give appointments; you have to go without one to be seen. When I asked (twice) to make an appointment, they told me it wasn't necessary and that the consultation fee was around €30. So I went one morning. It's true they saw me quite quickly, but they ended up charging me double the agreed-upon price for a 5-minute consultation and selling me a product that costs €20 online. So I understand the consultation wasn't actually €30, but €40. Again, the consultation only lasted 5 minutes, and they only gave my cat a cursory examination.

I'm not saying they're bad professionals at all, but on both occasions I went to ask, they didn't properly inform me about the prices, and they didn't give me the option to ask about the price of the product they sold me. The vet simply gave it to me as if it were included in the consultation fee without telling me the cost.

I understand that it's partly my fault for not complaining at the time. I'm new to the animal world (so to speak) and I don't know much about veterinary costs in general; I know they aren't cheap. But €61 for a 5-minute consultation and a hormone diffuser… I don't know, it seems a bit of a rip-off. I'm giving it 3 stars because, as I said, they aren't bad professionals, but I felt a bit cheated. I should add that the day before my appointment, I spent the whole day calling to try to schedule a visit instead of going in for an emergency (as I originally wanted). Out of 5-6 calls spread between 10:30 am and 2:30 pm, they didn't answer once. I don't understand why they even have a phone number…

Terrible service. I've been taking my dogs there since they were puppies, but the last few times I've had to take them, it's always the same: more than two hours waiting. People without appointments are let in later, and it's always the …
Amazing staff, great service, and reasonable prices
